tool_input.description: Compile and run probe program to observe actual style output

result:
Clean — `_tools/out` was regenerated by `test.sh` (which does `rm -rf _tools/out`), so the probe file is gone, and no stray artifacts remain outside it.

Created `MultilineRecursiveToStringStyleAgentTest.java` with 19 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering: blank/single/multi-field output, null and non-recursed values (String, primitive wrapper), primitive and object arrays (including empty and null arrays), reflective recursion into nested objects (with both direct append and `ReflectionToStringBuilder`, handling the force-accessible/non-force-accessible cases), direct calls to the protected/public `appendDetail` hooks, indentation-state isolation across sequential calls and across independent style instances, and `appendSuper`/identity-based equality. All tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
